# Paeds Resus

> Paeds Resus is an AHA-aligned Training Site and emergency-care organisation and platform based in Kenya, serving providers and institutions across all patient populations. Current institutional focus is Central Kenya; expansion across Kenya is planned, while East African Community expansion is not yet active.

## Canonical product architecture

### Individual products

- Self-Pay BLS: basic life support training for individual healthcare providers. Standard price: KES 10,000; current self-pay offer: KES 7,500; Black November offer: KES 5,500. The separate cohort rate is KES 7,500 per person for cohorts of 7 or more.
- Self-Pay ACLS: advanced cardiovascular life support training for individual healthcare providers. Standard price: KES 20,000; current self-pay offer: KES 17,500; Black November offer: KES 15,000. The separate cohort rate is KES 17,500 per person for cohorts of 7 or more.
- NERP: Nurses Emergency Readiness Program. Individual nurse pathway: KES 15,000 total, with minimum KES 2,500 monthly instalments; includes AHA ACLS certification and Paeds Resus BLS certification.
- IERP: Interns Emergency Readiness Program. The standard individual pathway fee is KES 15,000; it includes AHA ACLS certification and Paeds Resus BLS certification. The campaign enrolment cutoff is 30 November 2026; it is an enrolment deadline, not a payment deadline or temporary discount. The standard fee remains KES 15,000 after the cutoff, with no post-cutoff price increase. For interns whose IERP start date falls from 1 August through 30 November, Phase 1 online cognitive coursework and Phase 2 online team simulations may begin before payment. From 1 December EAT, the full remaining balance must be paid in one payment before continued access to cognitive coursework or booking further Phase 2 sessions. For interns whose IERP start date falls from 1 December through 31 July, the full KES 15,000 fee must be paid before Phase 1 or Phase 2 access.
- Paeds Resus Fellowship: individual paediatric emergency micro-course pathway. Fellowship micro-courses are free and distinct from paid life-support courses.

### Institutional products

- ILSP: Institutional Life Support Program for institution-paid life-support cohorts, delivery, practical assessment, and completion evidence. Paeds Resus BLS and ACLS training is KES 7,000 per provider for institution-paid cohorts; optional AHA certification is a separate add-on, with current pricing shown in the applicable course offer.
- IERS: Institutional Emergency Readiness System for hospital-wide emergency-response governance, activation, readiness evidence, drills, equipment gaps, corrective actions, and reporting. Annual price tiers (Levels 4/5/6): KES 200,000 / 350,000 / 600,000.
- ICPD: Institutional Continuous Professional Development for verified professional-development activity, attendance, targets, certificates, and leadership reporting. Per-staff price tiers: KES 1,000 / 900 / 800 / 700 / 600, based on verified staff bands.

## Products within IERS

- ResusGPS is a product within IERS and is the IERS bedside-guidance product. It supports structured paediatric emergency assessment, CPR timing, weight-based calculations, protocols, and reassessment prompts. It does not replace local protocols, senior clinical judgement, supervision, or emergency services.
- Care Signal is the improvement layer within IERS. It supports honest reporting and review of incidents, near-misses, and corrective actions. It is not a punitive reporting tool and is not a substitute for a formal clinical record.

## Institutional presence
Helping hospitals build emergency readiness through practical training, team learning, and continuous improvement.

Paeds Resus is based in Kenya, with our current institutional focus in Central Kenya. ILSP, IERS, and ICPD are built to scale to any facility in Kenya as we grow — East African Community expansion is planned, not yet active. Contact us to discuss your facility.

## Naming and claims rules

- Paeds Resus is the organisation and platform.
- Paeds Resus Limited is the training legal entity used on course pages.
- ResusGPS is an IERS product, not a standalone top-level institutional product.
- Use AHA-aligned unless the exact certification wording has been approved for the relevant course and delivery arrangement.
- Do not claim that software, training, or a certificate replaces clinical judgement, local protocols, supervision, or emergency services.
- Do not make unsupported mortality, competence, readiness, or certification guarantees.
- No facility, partner, case study, outcome figure, or testimonial is public unless the organisation has consented to publication.
